text:
Liz D: quick heads-up — I'm landing a tiny addition to the on‑prem quickstart: a minimal connectivity validator and a small note about KMS fallback order. Opening a PR in ~10. Would love quick review for wording and the snippet.
Mike R: nice. can you include a simple tcp check + an http/health check? makes debugging infra way faster.
Liz D: yesss. plan is two tiny snippets — netcat for ports, curl for health. also a short example to show checking PKCS#11 env vars for HSMs.
Anna K: please call out the PKCS11_LIB_PATH var and the common mistake of using the packaged lib path vs distro path. maybe a one-line troubleshooting tip.
Liz D: good call. I added this note in the PR description too.
Kevin T: what about airgapped customers — we should include instructions for validating local repo mirrors (apt/yum) connectivity vs external. small mention is fine.
Liz D: adding a short section "airgap sanity checks" with commands to validate catalog file presence + checksum.
Mike R: for netcat, show both nc -vz and ncat alternatives. some sites only have ncat. also show a fallback using /dev/tcp for POSIX shells.
Liz D: adding three variants. snippet draft:```bash
# TCP port check (nc, ncat or shell fallback)
nc -vz 10.0.0.5 443 || ncat -vz 10.0.0.5 443 || (echo >/dev/tcp/10.0.0.5/443) && echo "port open" || echo "port closed"

# Basic HTTP health check
curl -fsS --max-time 5 https://10.0.0.5:8443/health || echo "health check failed"
```
Anna K: for HSM PKCS11 check, something like:```bash
# check PKCS11 env
if [ -z "$PKCS11_LIB_PATH" ]; then
  echo "PKCS11_LIB_PATH not set — set to /usr/lib/<vendor>/libpkcs11.so or the HSM driver's path"
fi
```
Kevin T: for airgap checksum verify, show a sha256sum example and a note to compare to the release manifest we publish (link). maybe also remind to run as the installer user.
Liz D: added sha256 example and a short note: "If checksums don't match, do not proceed — re-sync mirror or re-download the release bundle."
Mike R: can we add a tiny troubleshooting blurb for KMS fallback: "if KMS unreachable, the installer will fall back to local encrypted keystores — call out where those live and how to rotate later". keep it short.
Liz D: included. text: "Installer will prefer remote KMS. On failure it uses local encrypted keystores at /var/lib/redwood/keys. Recommend arranging KMS retry windows in the infra runbook."
docs-ci: link-checker ran on the draft and found one relative link that 404s: docs/install/airgap -> should be docs/install/airgapped.
Liz D: thanks docs-ci — fixed the link and pushed a small follow-up commit.
sre-bot: deploy-check: docs build succeeded on staging (netlify-like), no broken anchors.
Mike R: tiny nit — for the curl snippet include -k only in examples where customers use self-signed certs; otherwise avoid.
Liz D: ok i'll add a parenthetical note about -k for self-signed local certs.
Anna K: LGTM from security docs side, left one inline about not shipping example PKCS11 paths as copy/paste.
Liz D: perfect. will squash and merge after 1 more 👀. thanks everyone :heart:
